page_title: VIL 0-0 BIL | Villarreal v Athletic Bilbao 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Ruiz de Galarreta I. Muscle Injury

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Junior Reis, who smothers the ball.
90+8' A cross from a corner kick by Ath Bilbao is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

90+7' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom right corner of the goal. Junior Reis displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Ath Bilbao earn a corner.
90+7' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
90+7' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Mario Melero had a clear view and blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Villarreal.
90+4' The resulting corner from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is cleared by the defence.
90+4' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao win a corner kick.
90+3' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
90+3' Mario Melero blows the whistle, Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Villarreal are awarded a free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent. Villarreal have a free kick.
88' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
86' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 8:8.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
83' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
83' Referee Mario Melero seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Pape Gueye (Villarreal).

82' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Pape Gueye (Villarreal) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
81' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mario Melero blows for a foul. Free kick. Ath Bilbao will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

80' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Junior Reis has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
78' Here is a change. Logan Costa is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Willy Kambwala (Villarreal).
77' Substitution. Sergi Cardona makes way for Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal).
77' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Villarreal due to a handball in the build-up play.
76' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Villarreal players aren’t happy.
75' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) fires the ball in and gets on the scoresheet!
74' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Gorka Guruzeta will be replaced by Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao).
73' It will be a substitution. Unai Nunez (Ath Bilbao) is ready to enter the pitch as Aitor Paredes walks off.
72' A corner kick by Villarreal is thwarted by the well prepared Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao).
71' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Villarreal manage to earn a corner.
69' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) latches onto a short pass from Gerard Moreno inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar.
68' 4:1 – this is the current number of shots on target. The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:5.
65' A pass from Alex Baena (Villarreal) is intercepted by Unai Simon and the move breaks down.
64' Substitution. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Unai Gomez walks off.
63' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Nico Williams is replaced by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Dani Parejo will be replaced by Pape Gueye (Villarreal).
62' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) latched on to a cross into the box and headed the ball under the crossbar. A decent header but it lacked power, allowing the goalkeeper to make a comfortable save.
60' The attendance is 19158.
57' Marcelino is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Tajon Buchanan suffers an injury and Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) comes on.
57' The substitution has been made. Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) has replaced Ayoze Perez.
55' Mario Melero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Villarreal, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
55' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
52' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
50' Corner kick. Villarreal will have an opportunity.
47' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) probably handled the ball. Ath Bilbao win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Ath Bilbao! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Mario Melero and both teams have no complaints.
45+3' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Ath Bilbao! Let's see what he decides.
45+3' One of the Ath Bilbao players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
45+3' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

45+3' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45+1' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
45+1' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
45' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Junior Reis.
41' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is first to react to a great cross from Nico Williams, but slices his shot well wide of the right post from inside the box.
39' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Juan Foyth (Villarreal) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
39' Alex Baena (Villarreal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

38' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the roof of the net, but Unai Simon gets a hand to it and keeps it out. Villarreal win a corner.
38' A quickly taken corner by Villarreal.
37' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
37' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Villarreal.
35' Yuri Berchiche is substituted due to injury. Ernesto Valverde gives a chance to Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao).
33' The game is interrupted now, Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Villarreal take a short corner kick.

32' This shall not pass! Alex Baena (Villarreal) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
32' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
29' Alex Baena (Villarreal) meets a perfect cross on the edge of the box and rips a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
28' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
28' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Villarreal earn a free kick.
25' Mario Melero blows his whistle and it's Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Villarreal are awarded the free kick.
24' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
21' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
20' Mario Melero blows his whistle after Dani Parejo (Villarreal) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Ath Bilbao win a free kick.

18' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
17' A pass into the box finds Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Unai Simon denies him.
15' Alex Baena (Villarreal) trips an opposition player and Mario Melero signals a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Ath Bilbao.
14' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
13' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
9' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
8' Mario Melero interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao). Villarreal have been awarded a free kick.

5' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Unai Simon dived superbly to block a header by Alex Baena (Villarreal) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the roof of the net, but Unai Simon pulled off a remarkable save!
3' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Alex Baena (Villarreal) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post.

3' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
2' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough foul. Mario Melero stops the game and makes a call. Villarreal have a free kick.
1' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Unai Simon intercepts the ball.
1' The first half has started.
Villarreal will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Mario Melero.
